meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能把网站部署到 Vercel 并生成公开网址。部署前会先本地构建并检查链接是否正常，确认能访问后才把网址发给你；也能管理 Vercel 上的项目、域名和环境变量。
howto.when: 当你说要“部署”或“发布”一个网站，或要“管理”Vercel 项目等时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目部署到 Vercel 的生产环境，然后返回链接。
say.note: 会先本地构建，部署并验证后再给你链接。

say.text: 列出我在 Vercel 上的所有项目。
say.note: 执行项目列表命令，返回项目名等信息。

say.text: 把 SECRET_KEY=abc 加为生产环境变量。
say.note: 会把它添加为生产环境变量。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude deploy websites to Vercel and get public URLs. Before sharing a link, it builds locally and verifies the URL responds. It can also manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to deploy or publish a website, or manage Vercel projects, etc.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production and return the link.
say_en.note: It builds, deploys, and verifies before sharing.

say_en.text: List all my projects on Vercel.
Add SECRET_KEY=abc as a production env var.
say_en.note: Adds it to the production environment.
